newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ayer Molek says may be taken over.
newsitem.headline: Ayer Molek says may be taken over.

text.p: Rubber and oil palm producer Ayer Molek Rubber Company Bhd said on Friday it was in negotiations which could result in a reverse take-over of the firm.
Ayer Molek said in a statement it was in "ongoing negotiation for the acquisition of substantial assets which could result in a reverse take-over situation".
The statement was issued by its merchant bankers to clarify the reason the company was asking for an extension to the stock's suspension.
The company two days ago asked the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to continue the suspension of its stock.
The shares were last traded on June 5 at 119.00 ringgit.
